subject: Post-demo: proposed 6-week evaluation & mutual action plan — Auriga Systems
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Mehta <samir.mehta@auriga.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@auriga.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: proposed 6-week evaluation & mutual action plan — Auriga Systems

Thanks again for your time today — great discussion on where Redwood could help with your support ticket summarization and knowledge retrieval use cases. Per our call I captured a compact evaluation plan to keep momentum and make sure stakeholders have clear success metrics. Please find the short proposal attached (auriga_eval_plan_v1.pdf) and the proposed mutual action plan in the attached spreadsheet.

High level (proposal):
- Duration: 6 weeks (2 weeks integration + 3 weeks focused evaluation + 1 week wrap-up + exec review)
- Success metrics: 1) 20% reduction in average first-response time for tier-1 tickets in test queue, 2) >= 85% relevance score on manual evaluation set, 3) <2% hallucination rate on core KB retrieval items
- Owner (Auriga): Samir Mehta (technical lead), Elena Ruiz (product sponsor)
- Owner (Redwood): Ben Carter (engagement lead), Monica Patel (customer success), Priyom Das (solutions engineer)

Proposed next steps (this week):
1) Sign off on scope and success metrics (Samir/Elena) — need confirmation by Fri 10/09
2) Provide a dev/test dataset snapshot and access details for a single support queue (Auriga IT)
3) Redwood to deliver integration checklist + trial runbook (attached: trial-runbook.xlsx)
4) Align on a preliminary schedule for a light-weight SOW (procurement loop)

Attachments: auriga_eval_plan_v1.pdf (PDF, 410KB) / mutual_action_plan.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB) / trial-runbook.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)

Quick ask: can you confirm the week of 10/19 works for a hands-on integration kickoff (30–60m)? If not, propose two alternative time windows.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to a short pilot.

—
Tessa Morgan
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0123
attachments: auriga_eval_plan_v1.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx

From: Samir Mehta <samir.mehta@auriga.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@auriga.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: proposed 6-week evaluation & mutual action plan — Auriga Systems

Tessa — thanks for the clear recap and the documents. Elena and I reviewed the success metrics and overall timeline; this looks reasonable. A few quick clarifications: 

- On the 20% reduction in first-response time: that target should be scoped to the pilot queue only (we have a dedicated five-agent team for inbound billing tickets).
- For the 85% relevance target, can you share the evaluation rubric you used? We prefer a 3-person blind review for the initial set.
- Procurement will want a short SOW + data handling addendum before we sign anything; I'll connect procurement after we agree on dates.

We can commit to the week of 10/19 for the kickoff; prefer Tue/Wed afternoons PST.

One more ask: can Redwood provide an optional configuration with a retrieval filter that excludes internal HR docs (we need to be careful about scope)?

If that all sounds good I can confirm sign-off by Friday.

—
Samir Mehta
Head of Platform Engineering, Auriga Systems
samir.mehta@auriga.com
+1 415-777-9010

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Mehta <samir.mehta@auriga.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@auriga.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: proposed 6-week evaluation & mutual action plan — Auriga Systems

Looping in a tighter engagement plan and owners. I updated the mutual_action_plan.xlsx with provisional dates and an initial task list (attachment). Key items for the internal team:

- Priyom: preliminary integration checklist (API keys, test endpoint, sample payloads) — can you scope this by EOD Thu 10/08?
- Monica: onboarding & success measurement — draft the evaluation rubric (3-reviewer template Samir requested) and the dashboard metrics we'll surface for the weekly check-ins.
- Tessa: will own scheduling and procurement touches.

Procurement note: Samir — happy to provide a short SOW outline and data addendum. I'll share a draft SOW link at the HubSpot record and attach a runbook (trial-runbook.xlsx) here for reference.

Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (updated), trial-runbook.xlsx

On Fri we should aim to close scope so procurement can be looped Monday. Priyom and Monica — once you have those artifacts, ping me and I'll bundle into a single packet for Samir's team.

—
Ben Carter
Engagement Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0198

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@auriga.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Mehta <samir.mehta@auriga.com>, procurement@auriga.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: proposed 6-week evaluation & mutual action plan — Auriga Systems

Thanks — all clear. We confirm the pilot scope limited to the billing-inbound queue. Tue 10/20 2:00pm PST works for the kickoff; Samir will attend and procurement has been copied (procurement@auriga.com) to start the SOW loop.

Samir/Procurement — please expect a short SOW + data addendum from Redwood by COB Mon 10/12 so we can review and route for signatures.

Two quick asks for Redwood prior to kickoff: 
1) Provide the evaluation rubric (3-reviewer template) and an example scoring sheet — Monica mentioned she'll draft this; please share the file.
2) Confirm the retrieval filter option (exclude HR docs) and note any limitations — technical note welcome from Priyom.

Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Product Management, Auriga Systems
elena.ruiz@auriga.com
(415) 333-2244
